claims.claim_en: Root ذَكَرَ (dh-k-r): meaning 'to mention, to remember, to mention something'. The verb in the aya (يُذْكَرِ) is built on this root.

claims.claim_en: Root اله (alef-lam-ha) / lemma اللَّه: denotes the divine name 'God' (the proper name of the deity).
